issuers.description: Italian bank and CEXA member, accredited to issue the reusable CEXA-Kyc credential from its own customer due diligence. It demonstrates the bank-to-exchange corridor: bank customers carry their KYC into crypto exchanges of the association without a second verification.

Swiss member exchange of the Crypto Exchange Association, accredited to issue the reusable CEXA-Kyc credential. After one full identity check, customers receive a KYC credential (name, birth date, nationality, KYC level, screening evidence) they can reuse to onboard at any other CEXA member exchange without repeating the process.

Independent Swiss repair shop that is NOT a Vesta Authorized Repairer. It issues badges to its own staff, but carries no Vesta accreditation: the contrast case showing how verification distinguishes authorized partners from everyone else.
issuers.projectContext: Vesta cast (appliance manufacturer and repair network)

issuers.description: Anchor of the CEXA trust ecosystem and sole issuer of the CEXA-VerifiedCounterparty credential: the Travel Rule identity issued to each member at validation and renewal, published on the member's DID as a Linked Verifiable Presentation and free to verify. As the ecosystem's organization anchor it is also an accredited issuer of the ECS-Service credential. For demonstration only.

Organization anchor of the Playground Ecosystem (demo): it owns the DemoCredential trust registry and, as an accredited ECS-Service issuer, delegates ECS-Service credentials to its four trusted sub-services (the accredited and unaccredited issuer and verifier of the personal-wallets demos). For demonstration only.

Reference issuer of the Playground Ecosystem, authorized on the trust registry to issue the DemoCredential. It serves anyone trying out the Verana playground: request a credential offer, receive a DemoCredential, and see a fully accredited issuance succeed end to end. For demonstration only.

A trusted Verifiable Service that is deliberately NOT authorized to issue the DemoCredential. It exists so wallet developers and demo audiences can see trust resolution reject an offer from an issuer without the required ecosystem accreditation.

A service that is not a Verifiable Service at all: no trust chain, no accreditation. It serves as the negative control of the playground, showing that compliant wallets refuse its credential offers before any data is exchanged.

National identity authority of the Republic of Verandia. Issues the Verandia Citizen ID (name, birth date, personal identifier, nationality, portrait) to citizens, and governs which relying parties may request it. As an organization anchor it is also an accredited ECS-Service issuer. The root identity credential of the Verandia use case. For demonstration only.

Company register of the Republic of Verandia. Issues Legal Representative credentials (company, registry ID, representative, role, powers) proving that a person may act on behalf of a registered company. Accredited by the Verana ECS Ecosystem as an issuer of ECS-Organization credentials (Business IDs), and an accredited ECS-Service issuer as an organization anchor. For demonstration only.

KYB issuer of the playground casts, accredited by the Verana ECS Ecosystem as an issuer of ECS-Organization credentials: it verifies and identifies the legal organizations behind the cexa, vesta and demo cast services. As an organization anchor it is also an accredited ECS-Service issuer. For demonstration only.
issuers.projectContext: Verana ECS Ecosystem (KYB for the playground casts)

issuers.description: Organization anchor of the Vesta Appliances manufacturer. Issues employee badges (ECS BadgeCredential: badge number, name, photo, title, department) to its own staff, and as an accredited ECS-Service issuer delegates ECS-Service credentials to its sub-services (Vesta Portal, Vesta Repair Network). For demonstration only.
issuers.projectContext: Vesta cast (appliance manufacturer and repair network)

issuers.description: Independent Portuguese repair company and authorized Vesta partner. Issues employee badges to its technicians so households can verify at the door that the person is a badged employee of an authorized repairer.
issuers.projectContext: Vesta cast (appliance manufacturer and repair network)

issuers.description: Iberian subsidiary of Vesta Appliances and regional issuer of the Vesta Repair Network: it accredits repair companies in its territory by issuing the Authorized Repairer credential to the company's DID (Zenith Repairs among them). For demonstration only.
issuers.projectContext: Vesta cast (appliance manufacturer and repair network)

issuers.description: Nordic subsidiary of Vesta Appliances and regional issuer of the Vesta Repair Network: it accredits repair companies in its territory by issuing the Authorized Repairer credential to the company's DID. For demonstration only.
issuers.projectContext: Vesta cast (appliance manufacturer and repair network)

issuers.description: Certification body accredited by the ISO Certification (demo) registry. After auditing an organization it issues the ISO 9001 (demo) quality-management credential, published on the certified organization's DID as a Linked Verifiable Presentation (Vesta Appliances holds one). For demonstration only; not affiliated with ISO.
issuers.projectContext: Vesta cast (appliance manufacturer and repair network)

issuers.description: Anchor of the ISO Certification (demo) registry, which accredits certification bodies as issuers of the ISO 9001 (demo) credential. As the registry's organization anchor it is an accredited ECS-Service issuer. For demonstration only; not affiliated with ISO.
issuers.projectContext: Vesta cast (appliance manufacturer and repair network)

issuers.description: Company register of the Republic of Verandia. Issues Legal Representative credentials (company, registry ID, representative, role, powers) proving that a person may act on behalf of a registered company, for use with banks and lenders in the Verandia scenario.

Reference issuer of the Playground Ecosystem, authorized on the trust registry to issue the DemoCredential. It serves anyone trying out the Verana playground: request a credential offer, receive a DemoCredential, and see a fully accredited issuance succeed end to end.

National identity authority of the Republic of Verandia. Issues the Verandia Citizen ID (name, birth date, personal identifier, nationality, portrait) to citizens, and governs which relying parties may request it. The root identity credential of the Verandia use case.

Organization anchor of the Vesta Appliances manufacturer. Issues employee badges (ECS BadgeCredential: badge number, name, photo, title, department) to its own staff, so customers and partners can verify who represents Vesta.
issuers.projectContext: Vesta cast (appliance manufacturer and repair network)
